question: Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana was implemented through which organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Employees Provident Fund Organisation**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY)** was launched in **2020** as part of the Aatmanirbhar Bharat package.
 
• The **Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY)** was implemented through the **Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)**.
 
• It aimed to incentivize the creation of new employment opportunities during the post-COVID recovery phase.
 
• The scheme provides subsidies for the provident fund contributions of new employees and their employers.
 
• The objective of ABRY is** to promote formal employment and reduce the adverse impact of COVID-19** on the labor market.
 
• The scheme targeted both new hires and those who had lost their jobs during the pandemic, encouraging businesses to re-hire.
